description: Localization language file for the CKEditor placeholder plugin in Vietnamese ('vi'). It defines Vietnamese translations for UI strings used by the placeholder plugin.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.setLang
methods.description: Sets the language translations for a specific plugin in CKEditor.

calls: CKEDITOR.plugins.setLang('placeholder','vi',{placeholder:{title:'Thuộc tính đặt chỗ',toolbar:'Tạo đặt chỗ',text:'Văn bản đặt chỗ',edit:'Chỉnh sửa ',textMissing:'The placeholder must contain text.'}})
